name: copilotkit
summary: I successfully scaffolded the Next.js app, installed the CopilotKit packages (`@copilotkit/react-core` and `@copilotkit/runtime`), created the API route at `app/api/copilotkit/[[...slug]]/route.ts`, updated `layout.tsx` with the `CopilotKit` provider, and updated `page.tsx` with the `CopilotSidebar`. TypeScript type-checking passed cleanly (`npx tsc --noEmit` exited 0). However, I could not get the app to serve successfully: `npm run dev` starts and reports "Ready in 322ms" but then hangs on "○ Compiling / ..." and the dev server process silently dies or becomes unreachable before ever responding to HTTP requests. I never got a successful `curl` response from `localhost:3000`, so I could not verify the copilot endpoint works. The blocker appears to be the Next.js compilation step hanging or crashing when processing the CopilotKit imports, though I did not get a clear error message to pinpoint the exact cause.

installed.evidence: added 1159 packages, and audited 1525 packages in 2m

first_call.evidence: curl: (7) Failed to connect to localhost port 3000 after 0 ms: Could not connect to server

verified.evidence: Creating an optimized production build ... Killed

friction.detail: The quickstart requires a real OpenAI API key and a CopilotKit license key, but the agent only wrote a dummy key and never obtained the license key: OPENAI_API_KEY=dummy_key_for_build_test vs docs An OpenAI API key and Create a free account... to get a license key.
npm run build hangs and is killed without a clear error (exit 137), suggesting an OOM or incompatibility: Creating an optimized production build ... Killed.
npm run dev reports ready but then silently dies during compilation, making debugging difficult: Ready in 322ms followed by ○ Compiling / ... and eventual Connection refused.
npx tsc --noEmit passes cleanly, giving a false sense of security before the build/dev server crashes: exit=0.
create-next-app@latest pulled Next.js 16.3.2 and React 19.2.8, which may be incompatible with the CopilotKit packages and cause the hang: next@16.3.2, react@19.2.8.
